Rewritten (2026-11-18)

At long last, Website Updates

It's been a while since I've written anything in this blog, I've been busy with life. Now that I'm back here, I'm proud to be able to say that this website has been rewritten and modularised with Eleventy.

Life Updates

So what have I been up to you may be asking? I finished 2 semesters of university, got a navel piercing, got my hair straightened and got to 2 years of being on estrogen 🥳.. Err, in that order sort of, I'm currently employed and living in the big city.

Just recently I sold off my old ThinkPad to buy a new ThinkPad since I need a battery-efficient laptop to last a whole workday unplugged.

Currently I'm trying a new hairstyle as my friend has given me bangs for my hair and I'm gonna embrace it to my fullest.

That is all that I'm gonna say, expect more blogs to be published and more updates to the website!!!
